text:
maria-cs: Heads up — multiple Dedicated customers reported throughput collapse + intermittent 5xxs for the last 45m. Tickets: #4521, #4523. P50 latency jumped 4x, observed 503s and spikes of 429. Customers say it started ~ when a deploy rolled out. Can eng-runtime triage?

jordan-eng: on it. which pool / model? any commonalities (model size, quantized vs fp16)?

maria-cs: affected pools: dp-dedicated-eu-3 and dp-dedicated-us-7. Models: mostly 13B variants, mix of quantized variants. Customer repro steps in support thread — they hit an endpoint with ~8 concurrent streams, then see many tiny batches and timeouts.

ben-runtime: quick hypothesis: continuous batcher packing collapsed -> many size-1 microbatches -> throughput drop. I've seen this when `max_batch_tokens` + pack timeout misaligns with request token distribution. Also check autoscaler logs; if autoscale didn't add nodes, small batches amplify latency.

neha-sre: I pulled cluster controller logs for dp-dedicated-eu-3 around start time (1753219400). There are repeated errors: `quota manager: allocate failed - quota exceeded (project=redwood-dedicated)` -> autoscaler suppressed. Snippet:```
2025-04-12T13:16:41Z controller ERROR allocate_node: quota exceeded
2025-04-12T13:17:02Z controller WARN autoscale: cooldown in effect
```

deploy-bot: deploy-event: canary release `runtime/scheduler-v2` promoted at 2025-04-12T13:14:02Z (commit e9a3f2)

jordan-eng: that lines up. scheduler-v2 changed pack heuristics (prefers request-count packing by default). If token counts vary a lot, that can create lots of undersized packs. Ben, can you pull `batcher.pack_efficiency` metrics?

ben-runtime: pulling now. `batcher.pack_efficiency` for dp-dedicated-eu-3: drop from 0.82 -> 0.22 at 13:14. Microbatch size histogram:```
size=1: 62%
size=2: 19%
size=3-5: 12%
size>8: 7%
avg_tokens_per_batch: 210
avg_tokens_per_request: 160
```
This is classic token-imbalance packing. Also seeing `pack_timeout_ms` spiking (lots of flushes).

maria-cs: customers also saw billing pulses (short spikes). one reported `throttled` errors in app logs.

sam-ml: model variant note — last night we pushed quantized kernel fallback for 13B that increases per-request token variance (some requests hit slow kernels causing longer tail latencies). That mixes poorly with pack-by-count heuristics.

jordan-eng: suggested repro steps for eng runtime:
1) run internal load generator against pool with same token distribution (we have sample prompt set in support ticket).
2) capture `batcher/debug` snapshot and `scheduler` trace.
3) check packer config: `pack_by` (tokens|requests), `max_batch_tokens`, `pack_timeout_ms`.

ben-runtime: I prepared quick local repro command for pool `dp-dedicated-eu-3` (internal only):
```sh
for i in $(seq 1 200); do 
  curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/pool/dp-dedicated-eu-3/infer \\n    -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEBUG_KEY" \\n    -d '{"prompt":"<sample from ticket>","max_tokens":256}' &
  sleep 0.02
done
```
Use `monitor batcher.metrics` while running. You should see pack sizes collapse if config matches production.

neha-sre: opened support ticket to cloud quota team to bump dedicated-node quota for `redwood-dedicated` and forced a temporary override to unblock autoscale. ticket #cloud-9876. I'll keep it pinned.

maria-cs: customer-facing note: i've told customers we're working on a fix and asked for any recent config changes on their side (no changes reported).

ben-runtime: quick mitigation plan:
- revert `scheduler-v2` pack_by default to `tokens` in canary pools or set `pack_timeout_ms` = 20ms -> reduces flushes.
- increase `max_batch_tokens` from 4096 -> 8192 for high token workloads to allow larger packs.
- temporarily relax `max_concurrent_inflight` per-pool to allow autoscaler to spread load (need SRE sign-off).

jordan-eng: +1. Also we should roll a lightweight patch to prefer token-aware packing when token variance is high (heuristic). That is safer than global revert. Sam, can you add metric to detect high token-variance to auto-switch packer?

sam-ml: can do. I'll prototype a `pack_switch` metric: if token_variance_ratio > 2.5 && pack_efficiency < 0.5 toggle to token mode. Estimate ~2-3h to get a canary.

neha-sre: autoscale override is in place, new nodes provisioned for dp-dedicated-eu-3 at 13:33. i'm watching for error recurrence.

ben-runtime: deployed a config rollback to canary pools to force `pack_by=tokens` and `pack_timeout_ms=15` at 13:42. Monitoring shows pack_efficiency climbing to 0.76 and avg microbatch size increasing. Errors are dropping.

maria-cs: customers reporting lower latency and no 5xx in last 10m. thanks team.

jordan-eng: follow-ups:
- postmortem draft (assign): ben-runtime
- permanent fix: sam-ml + jordan-eng on packer heuristic and safety flags
- autoscale quota: neha-sre to finalize with cloud team
- add e2e regression test simulating token-variance patterns: devex TODO

ben-runtime: creating postmortem draft now and will include repro steps + commands. assigning follow-ups in the doc.

maria-cs: will message impacted customers with ETA and root-cause summary. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
